Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study is primarily structural and biochemical, focusing on the assembly of the Pol II-TCR complex. The mass spectrometry component is used for cross-linking (XL-MS) and identifying ubiquitylation sites. While an in vitro ubiquitylation assay is performed with a control (no ubiquitin), the overall study is not a differential perturbation study of a biological system, but rather a characterization of recombinant protein complexes. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
